, Reason for Mistake: The Planner dismissed Henry III’s first coronation on 28 October 1216 at Gloucester as “not the proper coronation” and instead gave the later 17 May 1220 ceremony as the answer. The question asks when John’s eldest son was crowned; historically, he was crowned in 1216 (with a second coronation in 1220). The WebSurfer correctly surfaced both dates; the error was the Planner’s incorrect interpretation and selection of the date.
